2500.grammar: masc, dat sg of atta, atta group
2500.meaning1: for self; for oneself; to oneself

examples.text: saddhāya sīlena ca yā'dha vaḍḍhati, paññāya cāgena sutena c'ūbhayaṃ, sā tādisī sīlavatī upāsikā, ādīyati sāram'idh'eva attano'ti.
samantam'asāro loko, disā sabbā sameritā, icchaṃ bhavanam'attano, n'āddasāsiṃ anositaṃ.

2501.grammar: masc, gen sg of atta, atta group
2501.meaning1: of self; of oneself; one's own; my own

examples.text: puttā m'atthi dhanam'm'atthi, iti bālo vihaññati, attā hi attano n'atthi, kuto puttā kuto dhanaṃ.
sudassaṃ vajjam'aññesaṃ, attano pana duddasaṃ, paresaṃ hi so vajjāni, opunāti yathā bhusaṃ, attano pana chādeti, kaliṃ'va kitavā saṭho.
407, 439. parāṇy'attanopadāni.
453, 444. attanopadāni bhāve ca kammani.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo attan'tapo hoti attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano na-ehibhaddantiko natiṭṭhabhaddantiko n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.

2507.meaning1: acquisition of a self; personal existence

examples.text: tayo kho me, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhā, oḷāriko attapaṭilābho, manomayo attapaṭilābho, arūpo attapaṭilābho. katamo ca, poṭṭhapāda, oḷāriko attapaṭilābho?
oḷārikassa'pi kho ahaṃ, poṭṭhapāda, attapaṭilābhassa pahānāya dhammaṃ desemi, yathāpaṭipannānaṃ vo saṃkilesikā dhammā pahīyissanti, vodāniyā dhammā abhivaḍḍhissanti

2508.commentary: (MNa) attantap'ādīsu attānaṃ tapati dukkhāpetī'ti attan'tapo. attano paritāpan'ānuyogaṃ attaparitāpan'ānuyogaṃ.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, ekacco puggalo attan'tapo ca hoti attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, paran'tapo ca paraparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto.

2509.meaning1: devoted to the practice of harming oneself; engaged in the performance of self-mortification

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, puggalo attan'tapo hoti attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco acelako hoti mutt'ācāro hatth'āpalekhano na-ehibhaddantiko natiṭṭhabhaddantiko n'ābhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyati.

yv'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo attan'tapo attaparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ayaṃ me puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti. yo'p'āyaṃ, bhante, puggalo paran'tapo paraparitāpan'ānuyogam'anuyutto, ayam'pi me puggalo cittaṃ n'ārādheti.

2510.commentary: (ANa) attaparittāyā'ti attano parittāṇ'atthāya. parittaṃ nāma anujānāmī'ti attho.

examples.text: anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittāyā'ti.

2513.meaning1: hurting oneself; harm to oneself; self-affliction

examples.text: yaṃ nu kho ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo idaṃ me kāyakammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya
idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti.
piṇḍapātikassa bhikkhuno, attabharassa anaññaposino, devā pihayanti tādino, upasantassa sadā satīmato'ti.
santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, dviyojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, tiyojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, catuyojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā, pañcayojanasatikā'pi attabhāvā

2517.meaning1: incarnation; personal existence; individual form; physical identity

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko? yaṃ kho, bhikkhave, kāmayamāno tajjaṃ tajjaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinibbatteti puññabhāgiyaṃ vā apuññabhāgiyaṃ vā, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ vipāko.
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca. ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.

2518.meaning1: what is called the duality of personal existence

2519.meaning1: physical incarnation; individual existence; acquisition of individual identity

examples.text: atth'āvuso, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā c'eva kamati parasañcetanā ca. atth'āvuso, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe n'eva attasañcetanā kamati, no parasañcetanā.
kathañ'ca, thera, ekavihāro vitthārena paripuṇṇo hoti. idha, thera, yaṃ atītaṃ taṃ pahīnaṃ, yaṃ anāgataṃ taṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, paccuppannesu ca attabhāvapaṭilābhesu chandarāgo suppaṭivinīto.

2521.meaning1: physical incarnation; individual existence; acquisition of individual identity

2522.commentary: (ANa) attabhāvīnan'ti attabhāvavantānaṃ. (ANt) attabhāvo etesaṃ atthī'ti attabhāvino, tesaṃ attabhāvīnaṃ. ten'āha attabhāvavantānan'ti.

examples.text: katamā catasso? etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, attabhāvīnaṃ yadidaṃ, rāhu asur'indo. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmabhogīnaṃ yadidaṃ, rājā mandhātā.

2523.meaning1: for the sake of oneself; for one's own benefit

examples.text: ty'āssa sīlavato sīlaṃ, cāgaṃ sucaritāni ca, passamān'ānukubbanti, attam'atthaṃ vicakkhaṇā.

2524.synonym: abhiraddha, avighātavant, ānandī, āmodita, āraddhacitta, kalyarūpa, tuṭṭhi, patīta, patītarūpa, pamudita, pamodita, pahaṭṭha, pahaṃsita, pīṇa, pīṇita, matta, rata, vitta, sampahaṃsita, sammudita, sukhita, sumana, summana, somanassajāta, somanassita
2524.commentary: (MNa) attamanā te bhikkhū'ti sakamanā tuṭṭhamanā, pītisomanassehi vā sampayuttamanā hutvā.

examples.text: sace labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃcaraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, abhibhuyya sabbāni parissayāni, careyya ten'attamano satīmā.
purimen'ev'āhaṃ, bhante, opammena bhagavato attamano abhiraddho. api c'āhaṃ imāni bhagavato vicitrāni pañhapaṭibhānāni sotu'kāmo, ev'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ paccanīkaṃ kātabbaṃ amaññissaṃ

2526.synonym: abhinandi, abhirati, nandi, nandī, pīti, ratī

examples.text: alañ'ca pana vo, bhikkhave, tuṭṭhiyā, alaṃ attamanatāya, alaṃ somanassāya, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto dhammo, suppaṭipanno saṅgho'ti.
evam'eva kho, bhante, cetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko, yato yato imassa dhammapariyāyassa paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkheyya, labheth'eva attamanataṃ, labheth'eva cetaso pasādaṃ

2527.meaning1: words of satisfaction; expression of happiness; exclamation of delight
2527.commentary: (MNa) attamanavācaṃ nicchāresī'ti attamanatāya vācaṃ, attamanabhāvassa vā yuttaṃ vācaṃ nicchāresi udīrayi, pabyāharī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: so taṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya, pārupetvā attamano attamanavācaṃ nicchāreyya, chekaṃ vata, bho, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti!
atha kho, āvuso, paṇḍuputto ājīvako purāṇayānakāraputto attamano attamanavācaṃ nicchāresi, hadayā hadayaṃ maññe aññāya tacchatī'ti.
iminā ca mayaṃ, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitena attamanābhiraddhā. evaṃ attamanābhiraddhā ca mayaṃ, bhante, āyasmato ānandassa subhāsitena.
anujānāmi, bhikkhave, imāni cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena pharituṃ attaguttiyā attarakkhāya attaparittāyā'ti.

2531.meaning1: protected by oneself; guarded by oneself

examples.text: na kho pan'etaṃ, ācariya, evaṃ bhavissati. tvaṃ, ācariya, attānaṃ rakkha, ahaṃ attānaṃ rakkhissāmi. evaṃ mayaṃ attaguttā attarakkhitā sippāni c'eva dassessāma, lābhañ'ca lacchāma, sotthinā ca caṇḍālavaṃsā orohissāmā'ti.

ta'y'idaṃ na sādhu, ta'y'idaṃ nappatirūpaṃ, yaṃ tumhe seṭṭhaṃ vaṇṇaṃ hitvā hīnamattha vaṇṇaṃ ajjhupagatā yadidaṃ muṇḍake samaṇake ibbhe kaṇhe bandhupād'āpacce'ti. evaṃ kho no, bhante, brāhmaṇā akkosanti paribhāsanti attarūpāya paribhāsāya paripuṇṇāya, no aparipuṇṇāyā'ti.

2534.meaning2: just oneself; by oneself, for one's own sake

2535.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of attarūpa
2535.meaning1: for my own sake; in my own best interest; for my own good
2535.commentary: (SNa) tatra me attarūpenā'ti tatra mayā attano hitakāmajātikena.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, ye'me pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me attarūpena appamādo sati cetaso ārakkho karaṇīyo.

2536.meaning1: one's own intention; one's own volition

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā kamati, no parasañcetanā. atthi, bhikkhave, attabhāvapaṭilābho, yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe parasañcetanā kamati, no attasañcetanā.

2537.meaning1: due to one's own intention; because of one's volition

examples.text: tatra, bhante, y'āyaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābho yasmiṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhe attasañcetanā kamati no parasañcetanā, attasañcetanāhetu tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā kāyā cuti hoti.

2538.commentary: (SNa) so muni attasaññato'ti so buddhamuni hatthapādakukkucc'ābhāvena saṃyatattabhāvo.

examples.text: yo suññagehāni sevati, seyyo so muni attasaññato, vossajja careyya tattha so, patirūpañ'hi tathāvidhassa taṃ.

2539.meaning1: like for oneself; equal to oneself
2539.commentary: (SNa) yasmā pana attapemena samaṃ pemaṃ nāma n'atthi. mātāpit'ādayo hi chaḍḍetvā'pi puttadhīt'ādayo ca aposetvā'pi sattā attānam'eva posenti… tasmā bhagavā devatāya paṭigāthaṃ vadanto n'atthi attasamaṃ peman'tiādim'āhā'ti.

examples.text: n'atthi attasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi dhaññasamaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi paññāsamā ābhā, vuṭṭhi ve paramā sarā'ti.

2541.meaning1: accomplishment of self-development; (comm) fact of having an accomplished mind

examples.text: sīlasampannass'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ… yadidaṃ, chandasampadā… yadidaṃ, attasampadā… yadidaṃ, diṭṭhisampadā… yadidaṃ, appamādasampadā…
attanā hi kataṃ pāpaṃ, attajaṃ attasambhavaṃ, abhimatthati dummedhaṃ, vajiraṃ'v'asmamayaṃ maṇiṃ.

2543.meaning1: self-produced; arisen in oneself; internally generated

examples.text: lobho doso ca moho ca, purisaṃ pāpacetasaṃ, hiṃsanti attasambhūtā, tacasāraṃ'va sam'phalan'ti

2544.commentary: (SNPa) attasammāpaṇidhi nāma idh'ekacco attānaṃ dussīlaṃ sīle patiṭṭhāpeti, assaddhaṃ saddhāsampadāya patiṭṭhāpeti, macchariṃ cāgasampadāya patiṭṭhāpeti. ayaṃ vuccati attasammāpaṇidhī'ti.

examples.text: paṭirūpadesavāso ca, pubbe ca katapuññatā, attasammāpaṇidhi ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
attadīpā viharatha attasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā

2548.commentary: (SNa) attavadhāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhātī'ti taṃ assena saddhiṃ sampayojenti, sā gabbhaṃ gaṇhitvā kāle sampatte vijāyituṃ na sakkoti, pādehi bhūmiyaṃ paharantī tiṭṭhati, ath'assā cattāro pāde catūsu khāṇukesu bandhitvā kucchiṃ phāletvā potaṃ nīharanti, sā tatth'eva marati. ten'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: tatra kho bhagavā devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi, attavadhāya, bhikkhave, devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi, parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, assatarī attavadhāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti, parābhavāya gabbhaṃ gaṇhāti, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, attavadhāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi, parābhavāya devadattassa lābhasakkārasiloko udapādi. evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko.

2549.meaning2: possessed of a self, having an individual self

2550.meaning1: theory of self; doctrine of self

examples.text: taṃ, bhikkhave, attavāda-upādānaṃ upādiyetha, yaṃsa attavāda-upādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.
kām'upādānaṃ, diṭṭh'upādānaṃ, sīlabbat'upādānaṃ, attavād'upādānaṃ. idaṃ vuccati taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ.

2551.meaning1: related to a theory of self; regarding belief about identity
2551.commentary: (MNa) attavādappaṭisaṃyuttā'ti rūpaṃ attato samanupassatī'ti-ādi-nayappavattena attavādena paṭisaṃyuttā, tā vīsati bhavanti.

examples.text: yā imā, bhante, anekavihitā diṭṭhiyo loke uppajjanti, attavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā lokavādapaṭisaṃyuttā vā, ādim'eva nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno manasikaroto evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti, evam'etāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hotī'ti?

2552.meaning1: grasping a theory of self; clinging to a self-concept; attachment to a soul theory

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ? cattār'imāni, bhikkhave, upādānāni, kām'upādānaṃ, diṭṭh'upādānaṃ, sīlabbat'upādānaṃ, attavād'upādānaṃ. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, upādānaṃ.
taṃ, bhikkhave, attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyetha, yaṃsa attavād'upādānaṃ upādiyato na uppajjeyyuṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

2553.meaning1: making one's own wages; self-employed; living off one's own earnings
2553.commentary: (SNPa) attavetanabhato'ti attaniyen'eva ghāsacchādanena bhato, attano'y'eva kammaṃ katvā jīvāmi, na parassa vetanaṃ gahetvā parassa kammaṃ karomī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: attavetanabhato'ham'asmi, puttā ca me samāniyā arogā, tesaṃ na suṇāmi kiñci pāpaṃ, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.

2556.meaning1: one's own welfare; one's own benefit; one's own good
2556.commentary: (DNa) attahitāya paṭipannādīsu paṭhamo yo sayaṃ sīl'ādisampanno, paraṃ sīl'ādīsu na samādapeti āyasmā vakkalitthero viya. dutiyo yo attanā na sīl'ādisampanno, paraṃ sīl'ādīsu samādapeti āyasmā upanando viya. tatiyo yo n'ev'attanā sīl'ādisampanno, paraṃ sīl'ādīsu na samādapeti devadatto viya. catuttho yo attanā ca sīl'ādisampanno parañ'ca sīl'ādīsu samādapeti āyasmā mahākassapo viya.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti
attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya, parahitāya paṭipanno no attahitāya, n'ev'attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya, attahitāya c'eva paṭipanno parahitāya ca.

2557.grammar: sandhi, nt + nt + nt + nt + ind
2557.meaning1: one's own welfare, another's welfare, the welfare of both, and even the welfare of the whole world
2557.sanskrit: ātmahita + parahita + ubhaya + hita + sarvaloka + hita + eva

examples.text: so n'eva attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti, attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva so bhavaṃ gotamo cintento nisinno hoti.

2559.commentary: (MNa) attahetu vā parahetu vā'ti attano vā parassa vā hatthapād'ādihetu vā dhanahetu vā.

examples.text: na attahetu na parassa hetu, na puttam'icche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ, na iccheyya adhammena samiddhim'attano, sa sīlavā paññavā dhammiko siyā.
iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā na sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti

2560.meaning1: accepting and rejecting; picking up and throwing down; acquiring or discarding
2560.commentary: (NIDD1) attā'ti attānudiṭṭhi n'atthi. nirattā'ti ucchedadiṭṭhi n'atthi. attā'ti gahitaṃ n'atthi. nirattā'ti muñcitabbaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attaṃ nirattaṃ na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.
na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attaṃ vā'pi nirattaṃ vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.

2561.meaning1: self and no-self; what is personal or what is impersonal
2561.commentary: (NIDD1) attā'ti attānudiṭṭhi n'atthi. nirattā'ti ucchedadiṭṭhi n'atthi. attā'ti gahitaṃ n'atthi. nirattā'ti muñcitabbaṃ n'atthi.

examples.text: upayo hi dhammesu upeti vādaṃ, anūpayaṃ kena kathaṃ vadeyya, attā nirattā na hi tassa atthi, adhosi so diṭṭhim'idh'eva sabban'ti.
na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñ'ca vijjati, attā vā'pi nirattā vā, na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.

2563.commentary: (VINa) att'ādānaṃ ādātu'kāmenā'ti ettha sāsanaṃ sodhetu'kāmo bhikkhu yaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ attanā ādiyati, taṃ att'ādānan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā upāli bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, att'ādānaṃ ādātu'kāmena, bhante, bhikkhunā katam'aṅgasamannāgataṃ att'ādānaṃ ādātabban'ti?

2564.meaning1: having oneself as an authority; with oneself in charge

examples.text: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipako sako care, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī.

2565.meaning1: fact of taking oneself as an authority; putting oneself in charge

examples.text: tīṇ'imāni, bhikkhave, ādhipateyyāni. katamāni tīṇi? att'ādhipateyyaṃ, lok'ādhipateyyaṃ, dhamm'ādhipateyyaṃ.
so attānaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, att'ādhipateyyaṃ.

2566.meaning1: having oneself as an authority; with oneself in charge

examples.text: passanti devā ca tathāgatā ca, lokasmiṃ bālaṃ visamaṃ carantaṃ, tasmā hi att'ādhipateyyako ca, lok'ādhipo ca nipako ca jhāyī, dhamm'ādhipo ca anudhammacārī, na hīyati saccaparakkamo muni.

2567.meaning1: belonging to oneself; depending on one's own will
2567.commentary: (DNa) anatt'ādhīno'ti na attani adhīno, attano ruciyā kiñci kātuṃ na labhati.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso dāso assa anatt'ādhīno par'ādhīno na yenakāmaṃgamo. so aparena samayena tamhā dāsabyā mucceyya att'ādhīno apar'ādhīno bhujisso yenakāmaṃgamo.
saṅgho pabbatam'iva attānam'ācarati, pabbatāyati. taḷākaṃ samuddam'iva attānam'ācarati, samuddāyati, saddo cicciṭam'iva attānam'ācarati, cicciṭāyati

2569.grammar: masc, acc sg of atta, atta group
2569.meaning1: self; himself; herself; itself; yourself; oneself (object)

examples.text: nagaraṃ yathā paccantaṃ, guttaṃ santarabāhiraṃ, evaṃ gopetha attānaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.
rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.

2570.meaningLit: makes oneself not to be spoken to

examples.text: bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
mā āyasmā attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ akāsi

2572.meaning1: trusts oneself; has confidence in oneself

examples.text: so lābhasakkāraṃ jigucchanto pabbajjaṃ anupagantvā, pahomi c'āhaṃ lābh'ālābh'ādīsu nibbikāro hotun'ti attānaṃ takkento, visesato para-paribhava-sahan'ādi-paṭipadaṃ pūrento upekkhāpāramiṃ matthakaṃ pāpessāmī'ti

2573.meaningLit: oneself should be caused to fall

examples.text: so attānaṃ'y'eva adhipatiṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, att'ādhipateyyaṃ.
assutavā kho puthujjano attanā jarādhammo samāno jaraṃ anatīto paraṃ jiṇṇaṃ disvā aṭṭīyati harāyati jigucchati attānaṃ'y'eva [na] atisitvā, aham'pi kho'mhi jarādhammo jaraṃ anatīto
iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attān'ukkaṃsanā paravambhanā.

2576.meaning1: praises oneself (because of); exalts oneself (due to)

examples.text: ahaṃ kho'mhi uccākulā pabbajito, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū na uccākulā pabbajitā'ti. so tāya uccākulīnatāya attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, asappurisadhammo.
n'ev'attān'ukkaṃsissāma na paraṃ vambhissāmā'ti

2577.meaning1: sense of self; concept of identity; speculation about self; view that the self exists

examples.text: suññato lokaṃ avekkhassu, mogharāja sadā sato, att'ānudiṭṭhiṃ ūhacca, evaṃ maccutaro siyā, evaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passatī'ti.

2578.meaningLit: discourse on abandoning the concept of self

2579.meaningLit: discourse on the view of self

examples.text: siyā, ānanda! yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu attanā sīlasampanno hoti, no paraṃ adhisīle sampavattā, att'ānupekkhī ca hoti, no par'ānupekkhī, ettāvatā'pi kho, ānanda, bhikkhu saṅghe viharanto phāsuṃ vihareyyā'ti.

2581.meaning1: devoted to one's own welfare; practising for one's own development; engaging in meditation
2581.commentary: (DHPa) pihet'attānuyoginan'ti tāya paṭipattiyā sāsanato cuto gihibhāvaṃ patvā pacchā ye attānuyogaṃ anuyuttā sīl'ādīni sampādetvā devamanussānaṃ santikā sakkāraṃ labhanti, tesaṃ piheti, aho vat'āham'pi evarūpo assan'ti icchatī'ti attho.

examples.text: ayoge yuñjam'attānaṃ, yogasmiñ'ca ayojayaṃ, atthaṃ hitvā piyaggāhī, pihet'att'ānuyoginaṃ.
att'ānuvādabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, par'ānuvādabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, daṇḍabhayam'pi dukkhaṃ, duggatibhayam'pi dukkhaṃ… evarūpāni, mahārāja, bahuvidhāni anekavidhāni dukkhāni saṃsāragato anubhavati.

2583.meaning1: fear of self-criticism; fear of guilt

examples.text: katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, att'ānuvādabhayaṃ? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahañ'c'eva kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ, vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ, manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ, kiñ'ca taṃ yaṃ maṃ attā sīlato na upavadeyyā'ti!

2586.meaning1: grounds for making a declaration about the self and the world

2587.commentary: (MNa) att'ukkaṃsanakā paravambhī'ti ye attānaṃ ukkaṃsenti ukkhipanti, ucce ṭhāne ṭhapenti, parañ'ca vambhenti garahanti nindanti, nīce ṭhāne ṭhapenti, tesam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā nigaṇṭhā'ti.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā att'ukkaṃsakā paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

2588.meaning1: praising oneself and despising others; elevating oneself and treating others with contempt

examples.text: att'ukkaṃsakaparavambhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, sandiṭṭhiparāmāsā ādhānaggāhī duppaṭinissaggino, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, kuhakā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāp'icchā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, pāpamittā, bhikkhave, nigaṇṭhā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi asaddhammehi samannāgatā nigaṇṭhā'ti.

2589.meaning1: due to the defilement of elevating oneself and disparaging others
2589.sanskrit: ātman + utkarṣaṇa + para + viḍambanā + saṃdosa + hetu

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā att'ukkaṃsakā paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā att'ukkaṃsakā paravambhī araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, att'ukkaṃsana-paravambhana-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.
iti pubb'eva kho pan'assa susīlyaṃ pahīnaṃ hoti, dussīlyaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ, ayañ'ca micchādiṭṭhi micchāsaṅkappo micchāvācā ariyānaṃ paccanīkatā asaddhammasaññatti attukkaṃsanā paravambhanā.

2592.meaning1: intended for oneself; designated for oneself
2592.commentary: (VIN 1.2.6) att'uddesan'ti attano atthāya. (VINa) att'uddesan'ti, mayhaṃ esā'ti evaṃ attā uddeso assā'ti att'uddesā, taṃ att'uddesaṃ.

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā
mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena sassāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ bhikkhū abhinetabbā vatthudesanāya, tehi bhikkhūhi vatthu desetabbaṃ anārambhaṃ saparikkamanaṃ.

2594.meaning1: pertaining to oneself; concerning oneself; referring to oneself
2594.commentary: (VIN 1.1.4) att'upanāyikan'ti te vā kusale dhamme attani upaneti attānaṃ vā tesu kusalesu dhammesu upaneti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu anabhijānaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ att'upanāyikaṃ alam'ariyañāṇadassanaṃ samudācareyya iti jānāmi, iti passāmī'ti

2595.meaning1: pertaining to oneself; concerning oneself; referring to oneself
2595.meaning2: concerning oneself, applied to oneself, referring to oneself

examples.text: att'ūpanāyikaṃ vo, gahapatayo, dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti.
bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā bhagavaṃnettikā bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā. sādhu vata, bhante, bhagavantaṃ'y'eva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī'ti.
āyām'āvuso, yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamissāma. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocessāma. yathā no bhagavā byākarissati tathā naṃ dhāressāmā'ti.
yo'pi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇ'āsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano samma'd'aññā vimutto, so'pi pathaviṃ pathavito abhijānāti

2599.commentary: (MNa) paccavekkhaṇ'attho'ti olokan'attho, yaṃ mukhe vajjaṃ hoti, tassa dassan'attho'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: uṭṭhahatha nisīdatha, ko attho supitena vo, āturānañ'hi kā niddā, sallaviddhāna ruppataṃ.
taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rāhula, kim'atthiyo ādāso'ti? paccavekkhaṇ'attho, bhante'ti.
